messages:
Anna P: Quick sync — we need to validate the on-prem ingest gateway for the Snowflake + Databricks vector connector before the joint marketplace announcement. Targeting next Tue for the dry-run. Can infra and QA run smoke tests this week? :eyes:
Mike L: I can run smoke Wed AM. Need the sample dataset, schema mapping, and the gateway cert. Who's owning the sample?
Sophia R: I'll own the sample payload and listing draft. I'll create anonymized rows from the retail dataset and a schema mapping doc. ETA Mon EOD.
James K: I'll coordinate the gateway cert rotation with infra. Also we should confirm service-account permissions for reading Snowpipe and writing to the vector DB sink.
Mike L: For smoke tests, can you provide a minimal manifest + expected SLOs? e.g., 50 msgs/sec ingest, <200ms per record transform.
Anna P: SLOs: ingest 100rps burst, steady 40rps, end-to-end latency <500ms for small records. We'll relax for initial field trial.
Sophia R: Draft manifest uploaded: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INT/connector-onprem-manifest (private link). Includes mapping + example sample.json.
Mike L: Got it. I'll pull sample.json and run the local gateway against staging vector DB. Sharing quick smoke command:
```
TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/partner_token)
curl -v -X POST https://onprem-gateway.local/ingest \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  --data-binary @sample.json
```
Sophia R: FYI sample.json contains scrubbed PII, see manifest note. We should toggle telemetry off by default for partner PII.
James K: Agreed. Add a telemetry flag in the gateway config: telemetry.enabled=false for the pilot. We'll enable aggregate metrics only.
Anna P: @partnerships-bot reminder: we need a one-pager for the SI handoff (install steps + required roles). Can we get that by Tue morning?
partnerships-bot: Reminder: marketplace dry-run checklist -> create SI handoff one-pager assigned to @Sophia R, due Tue 09:00.
Sophia R: I'll attach the one-pager to the listing draft and create a short runbook for the SI with commands and config snippets.
Mike L: I'll run the following acceptance checks and paste results here after Wed run: connector starts, ingests 100 records, KV cache warms, no schema errors.
Anna P: Also need to confirm packaging for on-prem (helm vs docker-compose). Preference from partners is helm chart. Sophia, can you produce helm values example?
Sophia R: Yep — I'll add a values.yaml snippet to the runbook.
James K: Legal check: export controls & data residency? Tagging legal separately but we should note any country restrictions now.
Anna P: Good call. We'll not schedule any external announcement until legal confirms. Announcement hold: TBD.
Mike L: One more — telemetry/metrics endpoints we plan to expose to SI: /metrics (prom) + /healthz. We'll gate access behind mTLS.
Sophia R: Will document mTLS setup and cert rotation steps.
Anna P: Thanks team — next steps: Sophia sample + listing draft (Mon EOD), Mike smoke run (Wed AM) with results here, James certs + permission checks (Tue). We'll reconvene in this thread after smoke. :thumbsup:
James K: Sounds good. I'll post cert status update by Tue 11:00.
Mike L: I'll paste smoke output in thread once done.
Sophia R: One-pager uploaded once draft ready.
Anna P: Closing loop — if anything blocks, escalate to eng-ops. Thanks all. :rocket:
